message: I respectfully submit the [cozy UMN writing province](http://blog.lib.umn.edu/ratli008/1101/). :-) We started up the blog on Friday, and they're getting the hang of it very quickly. For context: The wild rice posts are in response to [this article](http://news.minnesota.publicradio.org/features/200209/22_gundersond_wildrice-m/), and a couple of students looked at Hit & Run and wrote about [this post](http://www.reason.com/hitandrun/2004/09/hating_america.shtml#006644).
